dog.description_text: Meet Little Bo Peep — New Arrival! Little Bo Peep just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FLittle%20Bo%20Peep%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQquGCdHjsCAQKAWcEfM%2DGHTEgUD1%2DDisaRy73nDTPOO04ZoxA Her foster says "From the start, Little Bo Peep has been so friendly and affectionate. She loves to climb under the covers in my bed, sleep in a basket of blankets, and sleep on my lap on the couch! She’s curious and a little playful but also very chill and calm. She occasionally uses her voice when people are talking in another room and she wants to be part of the moment :) ". She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
